descriptions.w3d_refresh_interfaces_802870fc: Pushes enable flags to up to three optional interfaces held at +0xf4/+0xf8/+0xfc through virtual slot +0x58: the first flag is the inverse of the +0xb0 word, the second mirrors +0xb0, and the third is the inverse of +0x8c. When +0x8c is zero, the first receives whether the +0xfc interface is null and the second receives zero.
